title: By myself / emphasis
note: The half a2_reflexives handed forward in writing. A2 kept only the interference core (*I feel myself good, *It happened me). This unit is by myself / on my own for alone, and the emphatic I did it myself. Third job: each other vs themselves, where Czech se / si covers both. First draft 2026-09-02, rough - thicken after smoke.

cards.title: By myself
points: Czech **sám** covers both jobs. English splits them by position.

cards.title: The -self words
points: You already know these words. These words do two more jobs besides the plain one.

cards.title: Alone, or without help?
points: **by** + self is about company. Self on its own is about who did the work.

rows: I went to the cinema **by myself**.
somebody could have helped, but I did it

cards.title: each other
points: Czech **si** covers both, so this pair has to be learned by meaning.

rows: A helped B and B helped A

cards.title: Common mistakes
points: **by myself** or **on my** own — never *by my own*.

rows: ~~She painted the room by herself alone.~~

items.explanation: **by myself** = alone. With **on** you would need *on my own*.
items.explanation_cz: **by myself** = sám. S **on** by to bylo *on my own*.

items.explanation: **herself** at the end means she did the work, with no help.
items.explanation_cz: **herself** na konci znamená, že to udělala sama, bez pomoci.

items.explanation: **each other** = A to B and B to A. themselves would mean each helped himself.
items.explanation_cz: **each other** = A B a B A. themselves by znamenalo, že každý pomohl sám sobě.

items.en: I did it on my own.
items.gap: I did it ____ my own. (on / by)
accepts: I did it on my own.
items.wrong: I did it by my own.
items.explanation: The set phrase is **on my own**, never *by my own*.
items.explanation_cz: Ustálená fráze je **on my own**, nikdy *by my own*.

items.en: He went to Prague by himself.
items.gap: He went to Prague ____ himself. (by / on)
accepts: He went to Prague by himself.

items.explanation: Plural **we** takes **ourselves**, at the end for emphasis.
items.explanation_cz: Množné **we** má **ourselves**, na konci pro zdůraznění.

items.cz: Děti se o sebe postaraly samy.
items.explanation: Each child looked after himself, so **themselves**.
items.explanation_cz: Každé dítě se postaralo samo o sebe, takže **themselves**.

items.en: Do you want to go by yourself?
items.gap: Do you want to go ____ yourself? (by / on)
accepts: Do you want to go by yourself?
items.explanation_cz: **by yourself** se ptá na to, jestli jdeš sám.

items.en: My parents write to each other every week.
items.gap: My parents write to ____ every week. (each / them)
accepts: My parents write to each other every week.
items.explanation: Two people writing in both directions: **each other**.
items.explanation_cz: Dva lidé si píší oběma směry: **each other**.

items.explanation: **myself** at the end stresses who did it.
items.explanation_cz: **myself** na konci zdůrazňuje, kdo to udělal.
